pageCache.pageTitle: Home - St Mary Magdalene and St Stephen's CE Primary School
pageCache.text:
Welcome! St Mary Magdalene & St Stephen's is a thriving school at the heart of vibrant, multicultural community. We believe in inspiring children not only to learn but to be confident in themselves and passionate about what they do. Our outstanding achievements in core developmental and learning milestones enables us to encourage children to find their own strengths through sporting activities and creative arts.
As a Rights Respecting school, we heavily promote an understanding, tolerance, fairness and respect for others at all times which helps to create a safe and trusting environment in which our children flourish.
Following the teachings of St. Paul, our school vision of 'I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me' lies at the foundation of everything we do. On this we build and foster the virtues of Moral Courage, Compassion, Forgiveness, Thankfulness and Koinonia.
We actively challenge all forms of discrimination, (recognising the unique value of each individual and) celebrating the diverse talents, passions and personalities that enrich our learning environment. We develop a shared culture of integrity, responsibility, mutual respect, self-discipline and non-violence, empowering our children to achieve their fullest potential, both today and as they embark on their future journeys tomorrow.

pageCache.pageTitle: Mission Statement - St Mary Magdalene and St Stephen's CE Primary School
pageCache.text:
Mission Statement
At St Mary Magdalene & St Stephen's CE Primary School, through Christian values, we aim to offer an outstanding education to all pupils regardless of their ethnic background, gender or religion.
We draw upon the richness of our different cultures, talents, passions and personalities.
We want our pupils to achieve and reach their full potential and capabilities, so that they can live fulfilled lives now and in the future.
Through our new Home/School Charter and our Rights Respecting Schools agenda, we work to bring about a feeling of trust between home and school, whereby the rights of everybody in our school community are respected (articles 3, 18, 28, 42).
We wish to develop a sense of personal integrity, responsibility, mutual respect, self-discipline and non-violence by providing a safe and structured environment within a caring community.

pageCache.pageTitle: Church - St Mary Magdalene and St Stephen's CE Primary School
pageCache.text:
Church
The school has a close relationship with both the church of St Mary Magdalene and the church of St Stephen's Westbourne Park. Children visit either the church every Tuesday for an assembly led by either Reverend Natasha Woodward or Reverend Richard Dryer.
Older classes also have the opportunity to take part in or observe a Eucharist service twice a term.
Throughout the year the school celebrates important events in the church with special services or a whole school Eucharist.
These events include One World Week, Advent, Ash Wednesday, Easter, our Christmas performance and our Leaver’s Service.
In Spring 2018, our ability to promote a Christian ethos which supports children's spiritual, moral, social & cultural development was judged as 'Outstanding'.

Sooper Books - Free School Library
Sooper Books is an award-winning digital story and audiobook platform. You can read or listen to hundreds of stories including original series and rhymes as well as modern remakes of classic fairy tales and fables. Sooper Books has kindly donated all of their award-winning stories and audiobooks to our school.
Sooper Books can be read or listened to using your computer, tablet or mobile device. No additional software or apps are required, other than an internet browser and an internet connection.
Please use the links below to access the stories and audiobooks free of charge from school or from home:
Bedtime Stories — A selection of the world’s best 5-10 minute bedtime stories and audiobooks.
Fairy Tales — A selection of classic fairy tales retold in a modern and fun way.
Sooper Series — A selection of original stories in episode format. Each episode is a separate 10-15 minute story.
Rhymes & Poems — A selection of 3-5 minute funny rhymes.
Aesop’s Fables — A selection of 3-5 minute moral tales, retold in a fun and modern way.

Kidz Club House
At Kidz Club House, we offer a safe, friendly and fun environment for children. On arrival, the children receive a light snack and drinks. Then at 4:00pm, children can select from a variety of specialist activities to take part in. We offer a variety of arts and crafts, sports and games activities run by different members of staff. Children can also get support with homework, and have access to computers and tablets when necessary.
Our staff are experienced and qualified. They ensure each child is looked after and has fun at Kidz Club House. Each session costs £9 (discounts are available for siblings and early booking). For more information or to book your child's place, please contact the office.
Kidz Club House runs Monday to Friday until 6:00pm. Please book your place using the School Gateway.
Should you have any questions about our school clubs, please contact the Office for further details.
